title: Hagia Sophia
sentences: For nearly a thousand years, this was the biggest cathedral in the world.
Emperor Justinian built Hagia Sophia in about five years, finishing in 537.
Its huge dome sits on a ring of windows, so it seems to float on light.
It lost the title only in 1520, when Seville Cathedral was finished.
After the city fell in 1453, Mehmed the Second turned it into a mosque.
It became a museum in 1934, and a mosque again in 2020.
